title: Friday's Pie Resource Pack
description: I love pie, its a great thing. I was told of the mission in my dreams to make a pie resource pack so i did.
body: Friday's Pie Resource Pack is a resource pack aimed at turning every item into a pie - such as the mace or the totem of undying. Every item becomes a pie. This project is ambitious, it will have issues and not be compatible with lots of mods. However, it does have appleskin support currently.
